## Welcome

This tutorial series covers single-cell RNA-seq analysis using Scanpy.

### Tutorials

1. [Quality Control](notebooks/quarto_annotated/scanpy_01_qc.qmd)
2. [Dimensionality Reduction](notebooks/quarto_annotated/scanpy_02_dimred.qmd)
3. [Data Integration](notebooks/quarto_annotated/scanpy_03_integration.qmd)
4. [Clustering](notebooks/quarto_annotated/scanpy_04_clustering.qmd)
5. [Differential Gene Expression](notebooks/quarto_annotated/scanpy_05_dge.qmd)
6. [Cell Type Prediction](notebooks/quarto_annotated/scanpy_06_celltyping.qmd)
7. [Trajectory Inference (PAGA)](notebooks/quarto_annotated/scanpy_07_trajectory.qmd)

### Setup

```bash
pixi install
pixi run python -m ipykernel install --user --name scanpy
```
